exchange.sent: What are the most important signaling test capabilities for applications in Semiconductor?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of the “most important” signaling test capabilities for Semiconductor; they only show that the 5G device value chain includes chip vendors and covers RF, Signaling, Application, OTA, Pre-conformance, Conformance approval, Carrier acceptance, Non-signaling RF, Signaling Protocol, and Service / repair testing [26][29][30].
### Signaling test capabilities explicitly supported by the passages
- Cellular and WLAN signaling coverage is central: the R&S CMX500 is described as providing LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling tests, with listed RF measurements including Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [66].  
- Application-layer signaling tests are explicitly listed as IP throughput, Video, Audio, and Protocol test in the CMX500 signaling test solution context [66].  
- IP application testing capabilities include DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, and web server under R&S CMX-KA100 [3].  
- Advanced application/IP capabilities include QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool, and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings under R&S CMX-KA110 [3].  
- IP traffic analysis is supported through R&S CMX-KA150, which provides an IP analysis tool for monitoring and analyzing DUT uplink and downlink IP traffic [3].  
- Voice and audio signaling/application tests include 4G and 5G IMS voice call codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB, and EVS under R&S CMX-KA180, POLQA perceived speech quality measurement under R&S CMX-KA181, and WAV player / recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay under R&S CMX-KA401 [3].  
- Callbox application and mobility use cases include Mobility Testing, Network Slicing, IP Throughput, Security Analysis, Backend Service, IMS Services, WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN, ATSSS, Power Consumption, XR Responsiveness & L4S, eCall / NGeCall, and Speech Quality [74].  
- Wi‑Fi 7 signaling R&D capabilities include testing wireless devices under cellular and non-cellular latest-generation standards, measuring RF TX / RX characteristics in signaling mode and real-world conditions, and Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests including 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [11].  
- Coexistence and desense testing are explicitly called out: WLAN + cellular in one box enables interference / desense testing against all LTE / NR bands with real connections, with examples including WiFi 4096QAM, 6 GHz band 320 MHz BW, EN-DC + WiFi7, and LTE + NR + WiFi measurements in parallel [22].  
- R&D callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, RedCap, desense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, SRS measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX Switching, Multi-SIM, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [8].  
- Pre-conformance and automation capabilities include CMsquares live views, App Testing, NTN live views, Sequencer, Log analysis, One-click RF testing, and quick switching from manual to automated pre-conformance using the same technology-specific license [73].  
- High end-to-end throughput testing is listed with 1024 DL QAM in FR1, 10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified, 1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2, and 10 Gbps E2E testing, though the source does not provide the test setup, DUT, band combination, software release, or report [24][92].  
- For manufacturing / production context, the stated goals include high yield, shortest possible test time, RF transceiver characterization and optimization, and debug and trace; the listed production-related tools include R&S CMX500 / R&S CMW500 for signaling [28].

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing
[[CMX500 use-case based 5G testing]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 market / solution positioning：以 use-case based approach 支援 5G eMBB、FWA、RedCap、NTN、XR 等裝置測試，而不只是一組單點工具。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › Shuffler
來源描述 [[Shuffler]]：

- RF / T-put test on all supported UE band combos in one go。
- All Shuffler tests part of [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] test package。
- Loop blocks provide flexibility to loop through bands、bandwidth、channels。
- one test script with one test report can test RF TX / RX measurement、RX sensitivity measurement、throughput、VoLTE / VoNR。
- Band combinations input via UE capabilities or user-defined Excel sheet。
- Shuffler implemented in [[R&S CMsequencer]]。

此處仍需正式 [[R&S CMX-KF612M]] 文件補證。[[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]]

CMX500_Callbox › 重點摘要
- Desense / interference 部分描述 WLAN + cellular in one box enables interference / desense testing against all LTE/NR bands with real connections，並列出 WiFi 4096QAM、6 GHz band 320 MHz BW、EN-DC + WiFi7、LTE + NR + WiFi measurements in parallel。
- 3GPP features 部分列出 Rel-15 SUL、Rel-16 UL TX Switching、Rel-17 extensions、Rel-17 PEI、Rel-17 1024 DL QAM、MIMO Nx6/nx8，並宣稱 10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified。
- Multi-SIM 部分描述 DSDS / DSDA：1 DUT、2 SIM slots、2 parallel connections、1 CMX；DSDS 通常 one TX / 2 RX、2 SIMs standby、一次一個 active connection；DSDA 為 two TRX、2 SIMs active connection at a time；option 線索為 [[R&S CMX-KS600B]] NR Signaling SA/NSA 與 [[R&S CMX-KS613B]] Multi-SIM Enabler。
- Callbox example use cases 包含 R&D verification of new bands、sensitivity testing、RedCap、de-sense testing、3GPP pre-conformance、SRS measurements、UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements、UL TX Switching、Multi-SIM、high e2e TP testing 與 non-signaling verification。

- [[EMITE]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 繼續合作，enhance [[EMITE]] 的 [[OTA testing]] measurement solutions。
- 合作內容是 fully integrating the latest test capabilities of [[R&S CMX500]] multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- 來源稱整合後除了支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]] 與 [[NR FR2]]，也支援 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 cellular technologies，包括 [[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz，以及 latest [[5G RedCap]] technology。
- 同一來源也說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 non-cellular technologies，包括 latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- 對 [[EMITE]] customers 的價值是取得 comprehensive environment，用於 accurately assessing the performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices。
- 下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] 與 [[NR NTN]]；來源稱這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源用背景段落說明 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 具 tens of gigabits per second、low latency，面向 ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality。
- 來源定義 [[RedCap]] 為 [[3GPP Release 17]] 的 5G technology，是 reduced-functionality version of 5G，相較 [[5G eMBB]] 成本顯著較低，具 mid-range data throughput、low power consumption、low complexity 與支援大量 devices 的能力，特別適合 [[IoT]] applications。
- [[David A. Sánchez-Hernández]] 以 [[EMITE]] CEO 身分表示，EMITE 將 testing chambers 升級到搭配 [[R&S CMX500]]，使 customers 可 extend capabilities to include [[IEEE 802.11be]] standard 與 Red Cap devices。

R&S TS8980FTA › 定位
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 用於 full conformance testing。
- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 與 [[R&S TS8980PRE]] 都是基於 [[R&S CONTEST]] 的 test systems series。
- [[R&S CONTEST]] 執行於所有 system configurations，通常在 system controller PC 上執行。
- R&S CONTEST-based test system series 用於量測 DUT 的 RF 與 RRM properties。
- DUT 需依適用情況符合 [[3GPP]] Release 99 到 15 的 GSM、WCDMA、LTE 或 NR 5G。

依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]：

- TS8980 family 被 presentation 定位為 `#1 RF/RRM conformance test system series`。
- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 在 family evolution slide 中被標示為 `validated tests`。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` 被描述為 standalone test system for FR2，for 3GPP-based RF / RRM conformance – GCF TP298。
- `TS8980FTA-3AM1` / `TS8980-3AM1` 被描述為 FR2 + FR1/LTE combo test system；來源圖上寫 `TS8980-M1` 有 FTA 或 PRE two flavours，並與 conducted + FR2 system 組合。

R&S TS8980FTA › TS8980FTA-M1
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- `TS8980FTA-M1` full type approval systems 支援 RF 與 RRM OTA conformance test cases。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` single-rack test systems 搭配 mmWave test chambers，例如 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 或 [[R&S ATS1800M]] CATR-based 5G NR mmWave test chamber。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` 設計用於滿足符合 [[TS 38.521-2]]、[[TS 38.521-3]] 或 [[TS 38.533]] 的 RF 與 RRM conformance test cases。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` systems 提供基於 [[R&S CMW500]] wideband radio communication tester 的 full signaling。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] remote radio head，擴充 [[R&S CMW500]] 對 5G NR FR1 與 FR2 的 signaling capabilities。

依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]（2020-11-02）：

- Slide 24 標題為 `TS8980FTA-M1: Standalone test system for FR2`。
- Slide 24 副題寫 `For 3GPP-based RF / RRM conformance – GCF TP298`。
- Slide 24 圖上列出 [[R&S CONTEST]]、[[R&S CMX500]] for 5G NR、radio heads for mmW、[[R&S CMW500]] for NSA / Sub-6、[[R&S CMX-RF42]] combiner、[[R&S FSW]] for spurious，以及 [[R&S ATS1800M]] chamber 圖示。
- Slide 24 的 customer-facing claims 包含：strong industrial servo drive for heavier and larger DUTs、targets both 3GPP + CTIA、vertical layout、more accurate DUT positioning、extensions planned including native CMX-FR2 support、extreme temperature testing、phantom heads & hands。

RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：本來源補強其作為 FTA / PRE 系列 test system platform 的 system-manual 層資訊。
- [[R&S TS8980FTA]]：full type approval 系列，支援 RF / RRM conformance test cases；FTA-3 / FTA-3A 為 FR1 / conducted 類系統，FTA-M1 為 FR2 OTA conformance 系統。
- [[R&S TS8980PRE]]：pre-conformance 系列，用於 R&D environment 的 design test / verification；PRE-3 與 PRE-3A 為 out-of-band pre-conformance systems，PRE-M1 為 CMX500 + ATS800R 類 setup。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]：所有 system configurations 上執行的 CONformance TEST software platform，GUI 可配置、操作與執行 test system / test cases。
- [[R&S CONTEST-based test systems]]：本來源可支撐的概念，指由 system controller PC、R&S CONTEST、CMX500 / CMW500、switching / conditioning units、analyzers、generators、power supplies、chambers 與 calibration / self-test 工具組成的自動化測試系統。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：系統主要測試儀器之一，用於 NR FR1 / FR2 signaling；在 TS8980FTA-3A / PRE-3A / M1 setup 中擴充 5G NR signaling capabilities。
- [[R&S CMW500]]：系統主要測試儀器之一，用於 LTE、WCDMA、TD-SCDMA、GSM、C2K、WLAN 等 signaling / baseband generation；可組成 [[R&S CMWflexx]]。
- [[R&S FSW]]：system manual 中作為 vector signal analyzer，用於 uplink signal measurements、spurious emissions、SEM、power，以及 LTE / WCDMA / 5G NR 等特殊 measurements。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：在 TS8980 systems 中作為 RF generator for interference，可實作 CW、noise、modulated interferer，也用於 RF calibration。
- [[R&S ATS1800C]] / [[R&S ATS1800M]] / [[R&S ATS800R]] / [[R&S CMQ500]]：OTA / radiated testing 相關 chambers 或 test systems。
- [[R&S CS-LDE3]] / [[R&S CS-LDE2]]：rack power distribution units。
- [[R&S SSCU3]]、[[R&S SSCU3-PRE]]、[[R&S SSCU-SE90]]：switching / conditioning / FR2 OOB frontend components。
- [[R&S CS-RUB]]：rubidium frequency standard 或 10 MHz reference distribution 相關元件。

- 來源列出很多 cabling plan、instrument addresses、PDU variants、fuse、rack 與 clearance 資訊；本頁只摘要核心資訊，詳細施工或維護仍需回原 manual。

RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 **R&S®TS8980FTA & PRE Series Test System Description, System Manual**，文件料號 `1173.9863.02`，**Version 63**，版權年份 **© 2025 Rohde & Schwarz**；來源未標示正式發布日期。

本手冊描述 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] 的 FTA 與 PRE 系列 test system variants：[[R&S TS8980FTA]] 用於 full conformance testing，FTA 展開為 full type approval；[[R&S TS8980PRE]] 用於 pre-conformance testing，PRE 展開為 pre-conformance。兩者都是基於 [[R&S CONTEST]] 的 automated test systems series，主要用於量測 DUT 的 RF 與 RRM properties，涵蓋依適用情況符合 [[3GPP]] Release 99 到 15 的 GSM、WCDMA、LTE 或 NR 5G DUT。

文件描述的 test system variants 包含：

- `R&S®TS8980FTA-3`
- `R&S®TS8980FTA-3A`
- `R&S®TS8980FTA-M1`
- `R&S®TS8980PRE-3`

- Application layer test：IP throughput、Video、Audio。
- Protocol test。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › UI 與 automation
來源將 [[CMsquares]] 描述為 web based、all-in-one configuration、all tools in one place、modern UI，並列出：

- live views。
- App Testing。
- NTN live views。
- Sequencer。
- Log analysis。
- One-click RF testing。

在 RF pre-conformance 脈絡中，來源稱可 quick switch from manual to automated pre-conformance，且使用 same technology specific license，並指向 [[CMX500 Sequencer Test Packages]] 與 `Sequencer-CMX-Test_Packages_Database.xlsx`。

CMX500 Callbox › Application / mobility use cases

- [[Mobility Testing]]。
- [[Network Slicing]]。
- [[IP Throughput]]。
- [[Security Analysis]]。
- [[Backend Service]]。
- [[IMS Services]]。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]。
- [[ATSSS]]。

- [[eCall]] / [[NGeCall]]。
- [[Speech Quality]]。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

R&S CMW500 › 重要限制
- 來源明示：[[R&S CMW500]] 有時只支援部分測試，某些測試需要進一步設備。
- 多個 CEN/TS 17240 IVS 測試需要外部 HMI interaction、ignition switched OFF 控制、manufacturer specific AT command、IVS debugging tool、prepared TestUSIM 或 handset；這些不完全由 KA09x software 控制。
- CTP 1.1.10.1-IMS limited service condition 標示 Partly Available；需 Prepared TestUSIM with Forbidden PLMN 001 02，且 attach reject by network not supported yet。
- CTP 1.1.17.2-IMS call-back abnormal termination 標示 Not available。
- 3GPP TS 34.229-1 21.3 標示 Not available。
- 來源註明 legacy CS domain eCall with inband-modem 到 [[NGeCall over LTE]] / IMS 的 transition 尚未由 EU commission 最終決定，因此部分涉及 handover 的 test cases 尚未實作。

R&S CMW500 › 軟體 licence / application options
[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 列出 GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE、Bluetooth、GPS、DVB、FM stereo、WLAN、LR-WPAN、TD-SCDMA、CDMA2000、NR analyzer 等大量 R&S®CMW-KMxxx、KSxxx、KWxxx、KGxxx、KNxxx software options。完整 order no. 未列於 data sheet，原文要求參考 product brochure PD 5214.2833.12 或 local Rohde & Schwarz expert。

R&S CMW500 › 支援技術摘要
- [[R&S CMW500]] 在 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 中是唯一明確支援 GSM small cell、WCDMA small cell、LTE small cell 的 CMW 型號。
- GSM、NB-IoT、WCDMA、LTE mobile station test 與 NR Sub-6GHz 章節明確標示適用於 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW290]]。
- Four RF paths、DAU B450H/I、Digital I/Q 1 to 4 / 5 to 8、Digital I/Q QUAD 章節明確標示 [[R&S CMW500]] 與 [[R&S CMW270]]。
- Bluetooth standard：Bluetooth Core Specification Version 5.0；test standard 包含 RF.TS.5.0.0 與 RF-PHY.TS.5.0.0。
- WLAN 160 MHz bandwidth unit 章節列出 IEEE 802.11a/g/p/n/ac 與 IEEE 802.11ax，bandwidth up to 160 MHz。
- [[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]] 補充 [[NGeCall over LTE]]、[[IMS eCall]]、[[IVS]]、[[PSAP]]、[[MSD]]、limited service、callback、clear-down、SRVCC handover 等 eCall 測試語境。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S CMW500 › 規格條件
- 未標示 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力。
- 規格以 24-month calibration interval 為基準，除非另有說明。
- 需至少 15 minutes warm-up time，環境溫度與指定 environmental conditions 符合要求，calibration cycle 已遵守，且所有 internal automatic adjustments 已執行。
- `typ.` 為 typical values，在 final test 中驗證，但 Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Nominal values 為 design parameters，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Calibration interval：12 months recommended for highest accuracy；24 months 時需在 specified RF generator 與 RF analyzer level uncertainty 加上 0.2 dB。

answer.text:
### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of the “most important” signaling test capabilities for Semiconductor; they only show that the 5G device value chain includes chip vendors and covers RF, Signaling, Application, OTA, Pre-conformance, Conformance approval, Carrier acceptance, Non-signaling RF, Signaling Protocol, and Service / repair testing [26][29][30].
### Signaling test capabilities explicitly supported by the passages
- Cellular and WLAN signaling coverage is central: the R&S CMX500 is described as providing LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling tests, with listed RF measurements including Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [66].  
- Application-layer signaling tests are explicitly listed as IP throughput, Video, Audio, and Protocol test in the CMX500 signaling test solution context [66].  
- IP application testing capabilities include DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, and web server under R&S CMX-KA100 [3].  
- Advanced application/IP capabilities include QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool, and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings under R&S CMX-KA110 [3].  
- IP traffic analysis is supported through R&S CMX-KA150, which provides an IP analysis tool for monitoring and analyzing DUT uplink and downlink IP traffic [3].  
- Voice and audio signaling/application tests include 4G and 5G IMS voice call codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB, and EVS under R&S CMX-KA180, POLQA perceived speech quality measurement under R&S CMX-KA181, and WAV player / recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay under R&S CMX-KA401 [3].  
- Callbox application and mobility use cases include Mobility Testing, Network Slicing, IP Throughput, Security Analysis, Backend Service, IMS Services, WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN, ATSSS, Power Consumption, XR Responsiveness & L4S, eCall / NGeCall, and Speech Quality [74].  
- Wi‑Fi 7 signaling R&D capabilities include testing wireless devices under cellular and non-cellular latest-generation standards, measuring RF TX / RX characteristics in signaling mode and real-world conditions, and Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests including 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [11].  
- Coexistence and desense testing are explicitly called out: WLAN + cellular in one box enables interference / desense testing against all LTE / NR bands with real connections, with examples including WiFi 4096QAM, 6 GHz band 320 MHz BW, EN-DC + WiFi7, and LTE + NR + WiFi measurements in parallel [22].  
- R&D callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, RedCap, desense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, SRS measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX Switching, Multi-SIM, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [8].  
- Pre-conformance and automation capabilities include CMsquares live views, App Testing, NTN live views, Sequencer, Log analysis, One-click RF testing, and quick switching from manual to automated pre-conformance using the same technology-specific license [73].  
- High end-to-end throughput testing is listed with 1024 DL QAM in FR1, 10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified, 1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2, and 10 Gbps E2E testing, though the source does not provide the test setup, DUT, band combination, software release, or report [24][92].  
- For manufacturing / production context, the stated goals include high yield, shortest possible test time, RF transceiver characterization and optimization, and debug and trace; the listed production-related tools include R&S CMX500 / R&S CMW500 for signaling [28].

NTN IoT device testing requirements › fading and path loss
來源指出 satellite connectivity 除 terrestrial fading profiles 外還需要 new fading profiles，包括 atmospheric fading 與 terrestrial fading 的組合，以及 rain、cloud、sun storms causing electron flow 等 weather-specific effects emulation。Large distance 造成 high free space path loss，導致 UE side low SNR。來源列出：

- Minimum SINR ≥ -10 dB。
- Minimum RSRP ≥ -137 dBm。
- NTN 第一階段目標為 outdoor connections。

Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices › 重點摘要
- [[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擴展既有合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software。
- 整合後，next-generation WLAN technology 的 developers 與 manufacturers 可使用 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 在 realistic conditions 下進行 MIMO stress testing。
- 來源以 [[Bluetest RTS65]] 為例，說明 [[Bluetest]] reverberation chambers 用於 wireless devices 的 over-the-air performance evaluation。
- 來源說明 reverberation chamber 與 anechoic test chamber 的差異：reverberation chamber 會在 chamber 內大量反射 RF signal，形成 Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment；此環境接近 real-world indoor and city conditions。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] 被描述為 complex wireless solutions 的 integrated test environment。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，具 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality、multiple radio technologies support 與 embedded IP test capabilities。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的 key components 被列為 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM modulation 與 [[MLO]]。
- 來源指出 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature；因此測試環境提供 multiple RF chains 很關鍵。
- Rohde & Schwarz 引言人物為 [[Christoph Pointner]]，職稱 Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers at Rohde & Schwarz。
- Bluetest 引言人物為 [[Kjell Olovsson]]，職稱 Bluetest CEO。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement，email 為 press@rohde-schwarz.com。
- Rohde & Schwarz 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- Bluetest 公司資訊：[[Bluetest AB]] based in Gothenburg, Sweden；來源稱其為 wireless equipment and small antenna OTA testing using Reverberation Test System 的 pioneer and market leader。

EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap › 重點摘要
- [[EMITE]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 繼續合作，enhance [[EMITE]] 的 [[OTA testing]] measurement solutions。
- 合作內容是 fully integrating the latest test capabilities of [[R&S CMX500]] multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- 來源稱整合後除了支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]] 與 [[NR FR2]]，也支援 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 cellular technologies，包括 [[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz，以及 latest [[5G RedCap]] technology。
- 同一來源也說 [[R&S CMX500]] 支援 non-cellular technologies，包括 latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- 對 [[EMITE]] customers 的價值是取得 comprehensive environment，用於 accurately assessing the performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] devices。
- 下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] 與 [[NR NTN]]；來源稱這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源用背景段落說明 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 具 tens of gigabits per second、low latency，面向 ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality。
- 來源定義 [[RedCap]] 為 [[3GPP Release 17]] 的 5G technology，是 reduced-functionality version of 5G，相較 [[5G eMBB]] 成本顯著較低，具 mid-range data throughput、low power consumption、low complexity 與支援大量 devices 的能力，特別適合 [[IoT]] applications。
- [[David A. Sánchez-Hernández]] 以 [[EMITE]] CEO 身分表示，EMITE 將 testing chambers 升級到搭配 [[R&S CMX500]]，使 customers 可 extend capabilities to include [[IEEE 802.11be]] standard 與 Red Cap devices。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 整合進 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers portfolio，可支援 latest technologies 的 reliability 與 efficiency 測試。

R&S TS8980FTA › 使用限制
- [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]] 是 system manual，不是 TS8980FTA formal datasheet 或 complete ordering guide。
- [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]] 未標示正式發布日期，只標示 Version 63 與 © 2025。
- [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]] 是 2020-11-02 customer presentation 的 lossy derivative，圖像與系統配置圖不完整；不可視為正式 specifications 或現行 support matrix。
- `TS8980FTA-3AM1` / `TS8980-3AM1` 在本來源中未提供正式 ordering structure、option code、BOM 或價格。
- Test case coverage、validation status、option / BOM、價格與最新 supported 3GPP release 需回查 release notes、test package documentation、R&S CONTEST hardware configuration 或正式 ordering document。
- 來源提到 Release 99 到 15 的 RAT / DUT scope；不可由此排除其他來源中較新 test packages 或 NR-NTN PR 的 Release 17 語境。
- 2021 roadmap 只代表 2020 presentation 時點的 planning view，不可推論已完成、已銷售或已 validated。

R&S TS8980FTA › 定位
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 用於 full conformance testing。
- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 與 [[R&S TS8980PRE]] 都是基於 [[R&S CONTEST]] 的 test systems series。
- [[R&S CONTEST]] 執行於所有 system configurations，通常在 system controller PC 上執行。
- R&S CONTEST-based test system series 用於量測 DUT 的 RF 與 RRM properties。
- DUT 需依適用情況符合 [[3GPP]] Release 99 到 15 的 GSM、WCDMA、LTE 或 NR 5G。

依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]：

- TS8980 family 被 presentation 定位為 `#1 RF/RRM conformance test system series`。
- [[R&S TS8980FTA]] 在 family evolution slide 中被標示為 `validated tests`。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` 被描述為 standalone test system for FR2，for 3GPP-based RF / RRM conformance – GCF TP298。
- `TS8980FTA-3AM1` / `TS8980-3AM1` 被描述為 FR2 + FR1/LTE combo test system；來源圖上寫 `TS8980-M1` 有 FTA 或 PRE two flavours，並與 conducted + FR2 system 組合。

R&S TS8980FTA › TS8980FTA-M1
依 [[RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63]]：

- `TS8980FTA-M1` full type approval systems 支援 RF 與 RRM OTA conformance test cases。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` single-rack test systems 搭配 mmWave test chambers，例如 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 或 [[R&S ATS1800M]] CATR-based 5G NR mmWave test chamber。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` 設計用於滿足符合 [[TS 38.521-2]]、[[TS 38.521-3]] 或 [[TS 38.533]] 的 RF 與 RRM conformance test cases。
- `TS8980FTA-M1` systems 提供基於 [[R&S CMW500]] wideband radio communication tester 的 full signaling。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]] remote radio head，擴充 [[R&S CMW500]] 對 5G NR FR1 與 FR2 的 signaling capabilities。

依 [[TS8980_RF_Conf_FR2_Customer_Presentation_Status_2020_11_02]]（2020-11-02）：

- Slide 24 標題為 `TS8980FTA-M1: Standalone test system for FR2`。
- Slide 24 副題寫 `For 3GPP-based RF / RRM conformance – GCF TP298`。
- Slide 24 圖上列出 [[R&S CONTEST]]、[[R&S CMX500]] for 5G NR、radio heads for mmW、[[R&S CMW500]] for NSA / Sub-6、[[R&S CMX-RF42]] combiner、[[R&S FSW]] for spurious，以及 [[R&S ATS1800M]] chamber 圖示。
- Slide 24 的 customer-facing claims 包含：strong industrial servo drive for heavier and larger DUTs、targets both 3GPP + CTIA、vertical layout、more accurate DUT positioning、extensions planned including native CMX-FR2 support、extreme temperature testing、phantom heads & hands。

RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：本來源補強其作為 FTA / PRE 系列 test system platform 的 system-manual 層資訊。
- [[R&S TS8980FTA]]：full type approval 系列，支援 RF / RRM conformance test cases；FTA-3 / FTA-3A 為 FR1 / conducted 類系統，FTA-M1 為 FR2 OTA conformance 系統。
- [[R&S TS8980PRE]]：pre-conformance 系列，用於 R&D environment 的 design test / verification；PRE-3 與 PRE-3A 為 out-of-band pre-conformance systems，PRE-M1 為 CMX500 + ATS800R 類 setup。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]：所有 system configurations 上執行的 CONformance TEST software platform，GUI 可配置、操作與執行 test system / test cases。
- [[R&S CONTEST-based test systems]]：本來源可支撐的概念，指由 system controller PC、R&S CONTEST、CMX500 / CMW500、switching / conditioning units、analyzers、generators、power supplies、chambers 與 calibration / self-test 工具組成的自動化測試系統。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：系統主要測試儀器之一，用於 NR FR1 / FR2 signaling；在 TS8980FTA-3A / PRE-3A / M1 setup 中擴充 5G NR signaling capabilities。
- [[R&S CMW500]]：系統主要測試儀器之一，用於 LTE、WCDMA、TD-SCDMA、GSM、C2K、WLAN 等 signaling / baseband generation；可組成 [[R&S CMWflexx]]。
- [[R&S FSW]]：system manual 中作為 vector signal analyzer，用於 uplink signal measurements、spurious emissions、SEM、power，以及 LTE / WCDMA / 5G NR 等特殊 measurements。
- [[R&S SMW200A]]：在 TS8980 systems 中作為 RF generator for interference，可實作 CW、noise、modulated interferer，也用於 RF calibration。
- [[R&S ATS1800C]] / [[R&S ATS1800M]] / [[R&S ATS800R]] / [[R&S CMQ500]]：OTA / radiated testing 相關 chambers 或 test systems。
- [[R&S CS-LDE3]] / [[R&S CS-LDE2]]：rack power distribution units。
- [[R&S SSCU3]]、[[R&S SSCU3-PRE]]、[[R&S SSCU-SE90]]：switching / conditioning / FR2 OOB frontend components。
- [[R&S CS-RUB]]：rubidium frequency standard 或 10 MHz reference distribution 相關元件。

RS_TS8980FTA_PRE_Series_SystemManual_en_63 › 原文未解的問題
- 來源未標示正式發布日期；只提供 Version 63 與 © 2025。

- 來源提到 DUT 需符合 3GPP Release 99 到 15 的 GSM / WCDMA / LTE / NR 5G，未說明是否涵蓋較新 release 或 NR-NTN Release 17；不可由此推論 TS8980 不支援新版 test packages。

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of the “most important” signaling test capabilities for Semiconductor; they only show that the 5G device value chain includes chip vendors and covers RF, Signaling, Application, OTA, Pre-conformance, Conformance approval, Carrier acceptance, Non-signaling RF, Signaling Protocol, and Service / repair testing [26][29][30].
### Signaling test capabilities explicitly supported by the passages
- Cellular and WLAN signaling coverage is central: the R&S CMX500 is described as providing LTE, 5G, and Wi‑Fi UE signaling tests, with listed RF measurements including Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER / BLER, and MIMO [66].  
- Application-layer signaling tests are explicitly listed as IP throughput, Video, Audio, and Protocol test in the CMX500 signaling test solution context [66].  
- IP application testing capabilities include DNS, IMS, Message Center, FTP, HTTP, DNS monitor, IP logging, iPerf, Ping, throughput, Max Throughput Wizard, and web server under R&S CMX-KA100 [3].  
- Advanced application/IP capabilities include QoS, ePDG, N3IWF, delay measurement, IP tune tool, and SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings under R&S CMX-KA110 [3].  
- IP traffic analysis is supported through R&S CMX-KA150, which provides an IP analysis tool for monitoring and analyzing DUT uplink and downlink IP traffic [3].  
- Voice and audio signaling/application tests include 4G and 5G IMS voice call codecs AMR-NB, AMR-WB, and EVS under R&S CMX-KA180, POLQA perceived speech quality measurement under R&S CMX-KA181, and WAV player / recorder, file-based POLQA, and end-to-end audio delay under R&S CMX-KA401 [3].  
- Callbox application and mobility use cases include Mobility Testing, Network Slicing, IP Throughput, Security Analysis, Backend Service, IMS Services, WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN, ATSSS, Power Consumption, XR Responsiveness & L4S, eCall / NGeCall, and Speech Quality [74].  
- Wi‑Fi 7 signaling R&D capabilities include testing wireless devices under cellular and non-cellular latest-generation standards, measuring RF TX / RX characteristics in signaling mode and real-world conditions, and Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests including 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities [11].  
- Coexistence and desense testing are explicitly called out: WLAN + cellular in one box enables interference / desense testing against all LTE / NR bands with real connections, with examples including WiFi 4096QAM, 6 GHz band 320 MHz BW, EN-DC + WiFi7, and LTE + NR + WiFi measurements in parallel [22].  
- R&D callbox use cases include R&D verification of new bands, sensitivity testing, RedCap, desense testing, 3GPP pre-conformance, SRS measurements, UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements, UL TX Switching, Multi-SIM, high end-to-end throughput testing, and non-signaling verification [8].  
- Pre-conformance and automation capabilities include CMsquares live views, App Testing, NTN live views, Sequencer, Log analysis, One-click RF testing, and quick switching from manual to automated pre-conformance using the same technology-specific license [73].  
- High end-to-end throughput testing is listed with 1024 DL QAM in FR1, 10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified, 1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2, and 10 Gbps E2E testing, though the source does not provide the test setup, DUT, band combination, software release, or report [24][92].  
- For manufacturing / production context, the stated goals include high yield, shortest possible test time, RF transceiver characterization and optimization, and debug and trace; the listed production-related tools include R&S CMX500 / R&S CMW500 for signaling [28].
